cohort: The study included nulliparous women who experienced vaginal birth at a tertiary hospital in Australia, using routinely collected maternity data from two time periods.
finding: The severe perineal trauma prevention program was associated with a reduction in severe perineal trauma rates from 8.8% to 5.6% in the nulliparous population.
mod_finding: Reductions in severe perineal trauma were observed across all modes of vaginal birth, being most pronounced in vacuum births, and episiotomy was found to be protective in all modes of birth for women of Asian country of birth and only in forceps birth for non-Asian women.
birth_weight: measured, with a focus on >=4000 gm
